title: Axe Compute Signs Penguin Solutions as Strategic Partner to Accelerate Delivery of Next-Generation AI Infrastructure as Demand for Axe Compute Build Surges
summary: Multi-year agreement expands Axe Compute’s deployment capacity to meet customer demand as contracted projects exceed $3.45 billion. PITTSBURGH, Oct. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Axe Compute Inc. ( NASDAQ: AGPU ), the neocloud that designs, deploys, owns, and operates dedicated, bare-metal AI infrastructure for enterprises worldwide, today announced a strategic partnership with Penguin Solutions (NASDAQ: PENG ), the AI Factory Platform Company, adding Penguin’s deep technical expertise, technology
body_markdown:
Penguin Solutions is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers.


With deep design expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, our Full-Stack AI Factory Platform combines differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate deployment, optimize token economics, and maximize the return on their AI investments.
